claims.text: Low-dose doxepin (Silenor): adults 6 mg once daily, 3 mg once daily may be appropriate for some patients if clinically indicated;
claims.quote: The recommended dose of SILENOR for adults is 6 mg once daily. A 3 mg once daily dose may be appropriate for some patients, if clinically indicated.

claims.text: elderly (65 and older) start at 3 mg once daily, which can be increased to 6 mg if clinically indicated.
claims.quote: The recommended starting dose of SILENOR in elderly patients (≥ 65 years old) is 3 mg once daily. The daily dose can be increased to 6 mg, if clinically indicated.

claims.text: Contraindicated with an MAOI now or within the past two weeks,
claims.quote: Do not administer SILENOR if patient is currently on MAOIs or has used MAOIs within the past two weeks.

claims.text: and with untreated narrow angle glaucoma or severe urinary retention.
claims.quote: SILENOR is contraindicated in individuals with untreated narrow angle glaucoma or severe urinary retention.
